test_title: PYST 18: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In January 2025, which theme was used to promote voting on National Voters’ Day?

options.text: Nothing Like Voting, I Vote for Sure

solution:
The correct answer is __**Nothing Like Voting, I Vote for Sure**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The theme for National Voters' Day 2025 was **"Nothing Like Voting, I Vote for Sure."** It aimed to create awareness about the importance of voting among citizens.
 
• The Election Commission of India (ECI) has been celebrating National Voters' Day every year on **January 25** since 2011 to mark its foundation day.
